title.zh: 美国土安全部下令将DeepSeek产品排除在联邦民用机构系统之外
title.en: DHS orders DeepSeek products removed from federal civilian agency systems

current_state.zh: 美国国土安全部要求联邦民用机构移除DeepSeek及相关产品；中国外交部已公开回应，批评美方将科技问题政治化，并承诺维护中国企业的合法权益。
current_state.en: DHS has ordered DeepSeek and related products removed from federal civilian agency systems; China's Foreign Ministry has publicly responded, criticizing the politicization of technology and pledging to protect Chinese companies' lawful rights.

updates.title_zh: 美国土安全部下令将DeepSeek产品排除在民用政府机构系统之外
updates.title_en: 美国土安全部下令将DeepSeek产品排除在民用政府机构系统之外
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国国土安全部下令将DeepSeek及相关产品（包括集成DeepSeek的第三方服务）排除在联邦民事机构采购之外，并从其IT系统中移除。
updates.what_changed_en: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security ordered DeepSeek and related products, including third-party services incorporating DeepSeek, to be excluded from federal civilian agency procurement and removed from their IT systems.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国国土安全部下令将DeepSeek及相关产品（包括集成DeepSeek的第三方服务）排除在联邦民事机构采购之外，并从其IT系统中移除。
updates.current_state_en: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security ordered DeepSeek and related products, including third-party services incorporating DeepSeek, to be excluded from federal civilian agency procurement and removed from their IT systems.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security ordered DeepSeek and related products, including third-party services incorporating DeepSeek, to be excluded from federal civilian agency procurement and removed from their IT systems.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security ordered DeepSeek and related products, including third-party services incorporating DeepSeek, to be excluded from federal civilian agency procurement and removed from their IT systems.

updates.title_zh: 中国外交部回应美政府禁用中国AI
updates.title_en: 中国外交部回应美政府禁用中国AI
updates.what_changed_zh: 中国外交部就美国要求联邦机构停止使用DeepSeek等中国AI产品作出回应，批评美方将科技问题政治化，并表示将坚决维护中国企业的合法权益。
updates.what_changed_en: China's Foreign Ministry responded to the U.S. requirement that federal agencies stop using Chinese AI products including DeepSeek, criticizing the politicization of technology and vowing to protect Chinese companies' lawful rights.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国国土安全部要求联邦民用机构移除DeepSeek及相关产品；中国外交部已公开回应，批评美方将科技问题政治化，并承诺维护中国企业的合法权益。
updates.current_state_en: DHS has ordered DeepSeek and related products removed from federal civilian agency systems; China's Foreign Ministry has publicly responded, criticizing the politicization of technology and pledging to protect Chinese companies' lawful rights.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: China's Foreign Ministry criticized the U.S. requirement that federal agencies stop using Chinese AI products including DeepSeek, calling it politicization of technology and vowing to protect Chinese companies' rights.
updates.detailed_summary_en: China's Foreign Ministry criticized the U.S. requirement that federal agencies stop using Chinese AI products including DeepSeek, calling it politicization of technology and vowing to protect Chinese companies' rights.
